asks.no_gesture: Where do you mean? Point at the paper.
asks.no_gesture.pointed: Where should it go? Point at the paper.
asks.no_object: I don't see anything there. Which one do you mean?
asks.no_object.empty: There's nothing drawn yet. What do you mean?
asks.unknown_label: I don't see a {label}. Which one do you mean?
asks.no_room: The sheet is full. Shall I start a new page?
asks.no_previous: There's nothing to adjust right now.

actions.name: place_drawing
actions.description: Draw one object from the drawable list at a place, at a size. Call once per object.

params.name: place
params.description: Omit if no place was spoken: the last pointing is used.

params.name: size
params.description: Omit if no size was spoken.

params.name: style
params.description: Only if the person asked for a simple or a detailed drawing.

actions.name: draw_connector
actions.description: Draw an arrow or line from one object or pointed spot to another.

actions.name: write_label
actions.description: Write text on the sheet. Copy the user's words for the text verbatim.

params.name: text
params.description: The words to write, copied verbatim.

actions.name: look
actions.description: Ask the camera/vision model a question about the sheet (what is drawn, where).

actions.name: new_sheet
actions.description: The user wants a fresh sheet of paper; clears the scene.
